set1.sentence: Mr. Boyles has been reviewing the contract with ------- legal team.
set1.correctSentence: Mr. Boyles has been reviewing the contract with his legal team.
set1.translation: Boyles氏は法務チームとともに契約書を見直している。
set1.explanation: 空欄の後ろに名詞 (legal team) が続いているため、名詞を修飾する所有格 his が正解です。he は主格、him は目的格、himself は再帰代名詞で、いずれも直後に名詞を置く形では使えません。

set1.sentence: The southbound train line is expected to be back in service -------.
set1.correctSentence: The southbound train line is expected to be back in service shortly.
set1.translation: 南行きの電車路線はまもなく運行が再開される見込みです。
set1.explanation: 動詞句 be back in service 全体を修飾する副詞が必要なので shortly が正解です。shortness は名詞、shorten は動詞、short は形容詞で文法的に合いません。

set1.sentence: ------- the next three weeks, Goodwin Supermarket will undergo remodeling.
set1.correctSentence: Over the next three weeks, Goodwin Supermarket will undergo remodeling.
set1.translation: 今後3週間にわたり、Goodwinスーパーマーケットは改装工事を行います。
set1.explanation: over the next + 期間 で「これから〜の間」という意味の定型表現になります。Upon, At, As はこの文脈では使えません。

set1.sentence: Lai Community Bank will ------- be offering a text message alert program.
set1.correctSentence: Lai Community Bank will soon be offering a text message alert program.
set1.translation: Lai地域銀行はまもなくテキストメッセージ通知プログラムを提供します。
set1.explanation: will soon be -ing で「まもなく〜する予定だ」という未来の予定を表します。soon が助動詞と be の間に入る自然な位置です。

set1.sentence: Mr. Sauer is checking the user manual to see if repairs -------.
set1.correctSentence: Mr. Sauer is checking the user manual to see if repairs are recommended.
set1.translation: Sauer氏は修理が推奨されているかを確認するため取扱説明書を確認している。
set1.explanation: 主語 repairs は「推奨される」対象なので受動態が必要です。動詞として機能する are recommended が正解です。

set1.sentence: Custodial staff are required to wear gloves when ------- the laboratory.
set1.correctSentence: Custodial staff are required to wear gloves when cleaning the laboratory.
set1.translation: 用務員は実験室を清掃する際、手袋を着用することが義務付けられています。
set1.explanation: when (they are) cleaning の主語と be動詞が省略された分詞構文で、能動の意味なので現在分詞 cleaning が正解です。

set1.sentence: The ------- of unsold food to charitable organizations can lead to good publicity for bakeries.
set1.correctSentence: The donation of unsold food to charitable organizations can lead to good publicity for bakeries.
set1.translation: 売れ残った食品を慈善団体に寄付することは、パン屋にとって良い評判につながる可能性があります。
set1.explanation: 文脈上「食品を慈善団体に寄付すること」が主語になるべきなので donation が正解です。

set1.sentence: The attached writing samples demonstrate my ------- skill in composing advertising copy.
set1.correctSentence: The attached writing samples demonstrate my advanced skill in composing advertising copy.
set1.translation: 添付の文章サンプルは、広告コピー作成における私の高度な技術を示しています。
set1.explanation: skill(技能)を自然に修飾できるのは advanced(高度な)です。eventual、durable、willing は意味的に合いません。

set1.sentence: To enter the hotel's parking area, drive ------- the fountain in front of the entrance.
set1.correctSentence: To enter the hotel's parking area, drive past the fountain in front of the entrance.
set1.translation: ホテルの駐車場に入るには、入口前の噴水を通り過ぎて進んでください。
set1.explanation: 「噴水のそばを通り過ぎて運転する」という意味になる前置詞 past が正解です。

set1.sentence: This year's Jazzo Festival will feature Penny Lee, ------- of the Jazz Music Award for Best Vocalist.
set1.correctSentence: This year's Jazzo Festival will feature Penny Lee, winner of the Jazz Music Award for Best Vocalist.
set1.translation: 今年のJazzoフェスティバルには、ジャズ音楽賞最優秀ボーカリスト賞受賞者のPenny Leeが出演します。
set1.explanation: カンマの後で Penny Lee を説明する同格の名詞が必要なので winner(受賞者)が正解です。

set1.sentence: Customers are calling to ask ------- electrical service will be restored by the end of the day.
set1.correctSentence: Customers are calling to ask whether electrical service will be restored by the end of the day.
set1.translation: 顧客たちは、電気サービスが今日中に復旧するかどうか尋ねるために電話をかけてきています。
set1.explanation: ask の目的語となる名詞節を導き「〜かどうか」という意味を表す whether が正解です。

set1.sentence: The pedestrian bridge over Mitchell Street will mainly serve ------- of Warner Heights.
set1.correctSentence: The pedestrian bridge over Mitchell Street will mainly serve residents of Warner Heights.
set1.translation: Mitchell通りにかかる歩道橋は、主にWarner Heightsの住民のために利用されます。
set1.explanation: 動詞 serve の目的語となる名詞が必要なので residents(住民たち)が正解です。

set1.sentence: Thanks to advances in manufacturing, solar panels are cheaper than ------- used to be.
set1.correctSentence: Thanks to advances in manufacturing, solar panels are cheaper than they used to be.
set1.translation: 製造技術の進歩のおかげで、太陽光パネルは以前より安価になっています。
set1.explanation: than 以下の節で used to be の主語になるため主格の they が正解です。

set1.sentence: ------- retiring from the university last year, Sami Talpur continues to publish scholarly papers.
set1.correctSentence: Despite retiring from the university last year, Sami Talpur continues to publish scholarly papers.
set1.translation: 昨年大学を退職したにもかかわらず、Sami Talpur氏は学術論文を発表し続けています。
set1.explanation: 「退職したにもかかわらず」という譲歩の意味になる前置詞 Despite が正解です。

set1.sentence: Irene Cross's submission to the logo design contest is certainly the most ------- we have received.
set1.correctSentence: Irene Cross's submission to the logo design contest is certainly the most creative we have received.
set1.translation: Irene Cross氏のロゴデザインコンテストへの応募作品は、間違いなく私たちが受け取った中で最も独創的なものです。
set1.explanation: be動詞の補語となり、the most と共に最上級を作る形容詞 creative が正解です。

set1.sentence: Achon Motors lowered its prices ------- maintain its competitiveness in a crowded market.
set1.correctSentence: Achon Motors lowered its prices in order to maintain its competitiveness in a crowded market.
set1.translation: Achon Motors社は、競争の激しい市場で競争力を維持するために価格を引き下げました。
set1.explanation: 「〜するために」という目的を表し、後ろに動詞の原形 maintain を続けられる in order to が正解です。

set1.sentence: The CEO congratulated the company's sales department ------- receiving last quarter's sales report.
set1.correctSentence: The CEO congratulated the company's sales department after receiving last quarter's sales report.
set1.translation: CEOは前四半期の販売報告書を受け取った後、会社の営業部門を称賛しました。
set1.explanation: 後ろに動名詞 receiving を伴い「〜した後に」という意味になる前置詞 after が正解です。

set1.sentence: The Hutchings Library has reported that the digitization of its special collections is ------- finished.
set1.correctSentence: The Hutchings Library has reported that the digitization of its special collections is nearly finished.
set1.translation: Hutchings図書館は、特別コレクションのデジタル化がほぼ完了したと報告しています。
set1.explanation: 形容詞 finished を修飾し「ほぼ完了している」という意味になる副詞 nearly が正解です。

set1.sentence: Our reporters' requests for comment from local officials were ------- declined.
set1.correctSentence: Our reporters' requests for comment from local officials were respectfully declined.
set1.translation: 私たちの記者による地元当局へのコメント依頼は、丁重に断られました。
set1.explanation: 受動態の動詞 were declined を修飾する副詞が必要なので respectfully(丁重に)が正解です。

set1.sentence: According to our data security policy, any files containing ------- information must be protected with a password.
set1.correctSentence: According to our data security policy, any files containing private information must be protected with a password.
set1.translation: 当社のデータセキュリティ方針によると、個人情報を含むファイルはすべてパスワードで保護される必要があります。
set1.explanation: 「個人情報」という意味になる private が文脈上正解です。constant、cautious、equal は意味が合いません。

set1.sentence: Applications for the internship program will be accepted through April 30, ------- it is wise to apply as early as possible.
set1.correctSentence: Applications for the internship program will be accepted through April 30, but it is wise to apply as early as possible.
set1.translation: インターンシッププログラムへの応募は4月30日まで受け付けていますが、できるだけ早く応募することが賢明です。
set1.explanation: 2つの独立した節をつなぐ等位接続詞が必要なので but が正解です。

set1.sentence: The proposal to acquire Lutzer, Inc., will be ------- at the board of directors meeting on February 2.
set1.correctSentence: The proposal to acquire Lutzer, Inc., will be debated at the board of directors meeting on February 2.
set1.translation: Lutzer社を買収する提案は、2月2日の取締役会で議論される予定です。
set1.explanation: 「提案が取締役会で議論される」という意味になる debated が文脈上正解です。

set1.sentence: Although their desired production timeline is not -------, Ms. Whitlock is reluctant to turn down such important clients.
set1.correctSentence: Although their desired production timeline is not reasonable, Ms. Whitlock is reluctant to turn down such important clients.
set1.translation: 彼らが希望する生産スケジュールは現実的ではないものの、Whitlock氏はそのような重要な顧客の依頼を断ることに気が進みません。
set1.explanation: be動詞 is の補語となる形容詞が必要なので reasonable が正解です。

set1.sentence: Suzuki Consulting is using the AskAway Web platform to ------- its first-ever customer satisfaction survey.
set1.correctSentence: Suzuki Consulting is using the AskAway Web platform to conduct its first-ever customer satisfaction survey.
set1.translation: Suzukiコンサルティングは、初めての顧客満足度調査を実施するためにAskAway Webプラットフォームを使用しています。
set1.explanation: survey(調査)と自然に結びつく動詞は conduct(実施する)です。

set1.sentence: In order to promote the health of citizens, the Sheridan Air Resources Board ------- the region's air quality.
set1.correctSentence: In order to promote the health of citizens, the Sheridan Air Resources Board monitors the region's air quality.
set1.translation: 市民の健康を増進するため、Sheridan大気資源局はその地域の大気質を監視しています。

set1.sentence: A background check is required for volunteers ------- duties are likely to involve handling money.
set1.correctSentence: A background check is required for volunteers whose duties are likely to involve handling money.
set1.translation: 職務にお金を扱うことが含まれる可能性が高いボランティアには、身元調査が必要です。
set1.explanation: 後ろの名詞 duties を修飾し「ボランティアの職務」という所有関係を表す関係代名詞 whose が正解です。

set1.sentence: Marvott Startup House has a unique ------- to fostering collaboration among its tenant businesses.
set1.correctSentence: Marvott Startup House has a unique approach to fostering collaboration among its tenant businesses.
set1.translation: Marvott Startup Houseは、入居企業間の協力を促進するための独自の取り組み方を持っています。

set1.sentence: We have been invited to present on our research because of its ------- to the conference's theme.
set1.correctSentence: We have been invited to present on our research because of its relevance to the conference's theme.
set1.translation: 私たちの研究は、学会のテーマとの関連性が高いことから発表に招待されました。
set1.explanation: relevance to 〜 で「〜との関連性」という定型表現になる relevance が正解です。

set1.sentence: ------- carefully farm workers may harvest blackberries, some amount of damage to the fruit is still to be expected.
set1.correctSentence: However carefully farm workers may harvest blackberries, some amount of damage to the fruit is still to be expected.
set1.translation: 農作業員がどんなに注意深くブラックベリーを収穫しても、ある程度の果実の損傷は避けられないと予想されます。
set1.explanation: However + 副詞 + 主語 + 動詞 で「どんなに〜しても」という譲歩節を作る However が正解です。

set1.sentence: Basham Technology ------- a set of guidelines on carrying out employee performance evaluations.
set1.correctSentence: Basham Technology has established a set of guidelines on carrying out employee performance evaluations.
set1.translation: Basham Technology社は、従業員の業績評価を実施するための一連のガイドラインを策定しました。
set1.explanation: 主語 Basham Technology は guidelines を「策定した」側なので能動態の現在完了形 has established が正解です。

set2.sentence: Critics say Ms. Yoo's new novel is too ------ to her previous books.

set2.translation: 批評家たちは、Yooさんの新しい小説は以前の作品とあまりに似ていると言っている。
set2.explanation: too similar to ~ で「〜とあまりに似ている」という定型表現になる similar が正解です。

set2.sentence: Choosing a good security system requires thorough ------- of the facility to be protected.
set2.correctSentence: Choosing a good security system requires thorough analysis of the facility to be protected.
set2.translation: 良い警備システムを選ぶには、保護対象施設の徹底的な分析が必要です。
set2.explanation: requires の目的語となる名詞が必要なので analysis(分析)が正解です。

set2.sentence: Always try restarting the program ------- your computer itself before contacting Information Technology.
set2.correctSentence: Always try restarting the program and your computer itself before contacting Information Technology.
set2.translation: 情報システム部門に連絡する前に、必ずプログラムとコンピューター自体を再起動してみてください。
set2.explanation: 2つの目的語(the program と your computer itself)を対等に結ぶ等位接続詞 and が正解です。

set2.sentence: After sales of its low-salt snacks fell, Bruster Foods ------- removed them from shops.
set2.correctSentence: After sales of its low-salt snacks fell, Bruster Foods quietly removed them from shops.
set2.translation: 低塩スナックの売上が落ちた後、Bruster Foods社はひっそりと店頭からそれらを撤去しました。

set2.sentence: The reporter took some pictures ------- once it became clear that the photographer would not arrive in time.
set2.correctSentence: The reporter took some pictures himself once it became clear that the photographer would not arrive in time.

set2.explanation: 「記者自身が」という強調の意味を加える再帰代名詞 himself が正解です。

set2.sentence: In order to obtain this visa, applicants must ------- that they are family members of a citizen.
set2.correctSentence: In order to obtain this visa, applicants must prove that they are family members of a citizen.
set2.translation: このビザを取得するには、申請者は自分が市民の家族であることを証明しなければならない。
set2.explanation: prove that ~ で「〜であることを証明する」という意味になる prove が正解です。

set2.sentence: The judging ------- for the Mares Prize is made up of scientists from a variety of specialties.
set2.correctSentence: The judging committee for the Mares Prize is made up of scientists from a variety of specialties.

set2.explanation: 「審査委員会」という意味になる committee が正解です。

set2.sentence: The estimated shipping time for your order is ------- three and five business days.

set2.sentence: Daniel Sinclair will take over Ms. Sosa's position until a ------- replacement is hired.

set2.sentence: While each offers beautiful views to hikers, Pine Trail is ------- easier than Oak Trail.

set2.sentence: Downloading all of the necessary software programs ------- almost five minutes even with a fast Internet connection.
set2.correctSentence: Downloading all of the necessary software programs takes almost five minutes even with a fast Internet connection.
set2.translation: 必要なソフトウェアプログラムをすべてダウンロードするには、高速インターネット接続でもほぼ5分かかります。

set2.sentence: Customer reviews indicate that many modern smart devices are often unnecessarily -------.

set2.explanation: be動詞の補語となる形容詞が必要なので complicated(複雑な)が正解です。

set2.sentence: To avoid wasting energy, do not run your dishwasher until it is ------- full of dirty dishes.

set2.explanation: 形容詞 full を修飾する副詞が必要なので completely(完全に)が正解です。

set2.sentence: Since the apartment complex was built, there has been growing ------- for more public transportation in the neighborhood.

set2.sentence: On this week's episode of Quiz Game, a schoolteacher was the only contestant ------- the final question correctly.

set2.sentence: The employee discount is an attractive perk, ------- it is only available after six months of work.

set2.sentence: The proposed ordinance would make wearing a helmet ------- for all bicyclists in the city.

set2.explanation: packaging を修飾し「保護包装」という意味になる protective が正解です。

set2.sentence: The "Find My Fone" app will be more useful when it becomes able to determine a device's location more -------.

set2.sentence: Prentice Lake's water level has risen by six inches ------- persistent rainfall over the past week.
